title: Paris police arrest man who wounded three women with knives
facts: A knife attack in the Porte de Clichy area of northern Paris wounded three women aged 19, 24, and 36.
The knife assault in Paris occurred at approximately 11:30 am (0930 GMT) on July 27, 2026.
French Interior Minister Laurent Nunez stated that two of the victims were in serious, critical condition.
One female victim sustained a stab wound to the lower back, while another was struck in the abdomen.
Geoffroy Boulard serves as the mayor of the 17th arrondissement of Paris.
Geoffroy Boulard stated on social media platform X that one of the injured women was pregnant.
An off-duty police officer intervened and apprehended the male knife-wielding suspect.
Eyewitness Kheira Dellabed, aged 54, observed the assailant carrying two knives during the attack.
A young bystander struck the suspect with a small suitcase to knock him to the ground.
A restaurant waiter placed a chair over the fallen suspect to help restrain him.
Laurent Nunez confirmed that the apprehended suspect made incoherent statements following his arrest.
A separate vehicle-ramming attack occurred at a Pride parade in Berlin on Saturday, July 25, 2026.
The Berlin vehicle attack killed one woman and injured 29 people.
The Berlin attacker used a rented minivan to target parade participants.
The Porte de Clichy knife attack occurred within the 17th district of Paris.
